# MarketLink

> MarketLink connects local farmers-market growers with customers. Browse markets and stalls on a map, see what is in stock, pre-order produce and pay in person at pickup.

## Pages

- [Home](/): overview, featured products and growers
- [Markets](/markets): find farmers markets by day and location
- [Products](/products): search and filter produce, dairy, baked goods and more
- [Harvest calendar](/harvest): upcoming produce announced by farmers
- [About](/about): about the platform and team
- [Contact](/contact): contact details and location
